# Apna Shehar — India City Builder

> An isometric Indian city-building game in **pure vanilla JS ES modules** —
> canvas 2.5D, zero dependencies, zero images, zero build step. Day/night
> follows **real Indian Standard Time (UTC+05:30)**. Visitors walk the city
> street-level (buildacountry play pattern); four bracket-named NPCs own its
> homes and shops like a metaverse deed book.

- Live: https://superz1402.github.io/india-city-builder/
- Repo: https://github.com/superz1402/india-city-builder
- Machine-readable content catalog: `catalog.json` (this site, repo root)
- Walk-mode reverse-engineering notes: `docs/WALK-REFERENCE.md` (repo)
- Regenerate the catalog: `node scripts/catalog.mjs`

## Catalog schema (v4 — polyfork schema + lemo-opuscar filmStyles)

```jsonc
{
  "site": "...", "licence": "...", "api": "<this file>",
  "counts": { "assets": 48, "kits": 8, "knobbed": 21, "residents": 4, ... },
  "kits":   [ { "id": "mohalla-homes", "name": "Mohalla Homes", "category": "house", "parts": 6 } ],
  "assets": [ {
    "id": "jhuggi", "title": "Jhuggi", "type": "building", "kit": "mohalla-homes",
    "category": "house",
    "stats": { "cost": 400, "homes": 5, "income": 0, ... },
    "knobs": { "tarp": { "options": ["slate","clay","teal","plum"], "colors": { ... } } },
    "def": "js/data.js BUILDINGS.jhuggi",
    "art": "js/arts.js drawBuilding case 'jhuggi'"
  } ],
  "residents": [...], "deeds": [...], "tiers": [...], "seasons": [...], "festivals": [...],
  "filmStyles": [ {
    "slug": "tilt-shift", "name": "Tilt-Shift Miniature", "film": "Toy Town Rush Hour",
    "line": "Morning rush hour in a town that looks like a model: traffic, trains and tiny people.",
    "adaptedAs": { "postFx": "js/tiltshift.js", "rushHour": "js/clock.js rushLevel()", ... },
    "source": "https://github.com/lemomo-ai/lemo-opuscar — styles/tilt-shift"
  } ]
}
```

`type` is `building` (all categories except decor), `prop` (road/bridge/
lamp/flag) or `nature` (tree). Farm assets also carry `seasonResponse` —
they react to the four in-game seasons natively (wheat golds at harvest,
paddy floods in monsoon, mango fruits in summer).

## Parametric knobs ("a model is a program", polyfork-style)

Every knobbed building resolves its look **deterministically from the plot
seed** — the same tile always wears the same colourway — so a city shows
stable per-plot variety with no saved art. `KNOBS` in `js/data.js` is the
registry; option 0 of every knob is the original pre-knob look.

Pin one per tile in code (the owner maintains everything code-side):

```js
place(18, 18, 'pakka', { knobs: { paint: 'teal' } });
// invalid knob or option → { ok: false, why: "paint: 'x' — valid options: cream, teal, pink, ochre" }
```

Pins live on the grid cell, persist in save v2 (`knobs: {"x,y": {...}}`)
and migrate cleanly: v1 saves load unchanged.

**In-game the player pins the same way** (no code needed): in plan mode,
tap a knobbed building — the tile card lists each knob as a row of chips
("Looks"). Tap a chip to pin that option; tap the pinned chip again
(outlined) to return to the seeded look. Pins go through
`pinKnob(x, y, knob, option)` (`null` unpins) and autosave handles the rest.

## Tilt-Shift Miniature lens (adapted from lemo-opuscar styles/tilt-shift)

The renderer ships a film-style post pass, dependency-free on canvas 2D:

- **Blur band** — only a tilted horizontal strip of the frame is sharp;
  above/below melts into blur (two masked blur layers = gradual DoF). The
  band follows the map focus in plan mode and the PLAYER in walk mode.
- **Grade** — saturation boost, added contrast, warm highlights, vignette;
  saturation lowered at night.
- **Toy Town Rush Hour** — `rushLevel()` reads the REAL IST clock: the
  vehicle fleet (~3 at 6 am → ~54 at peak), speeds and procedural two-tone
  horns follow India's commute curve (morning ~8–11, evening ~5–8:30 pm).
- **Time-lapse** — plan mode + lens on: agents step like wind-up toys and
  run ~2.2×; walk mode stays at real speed (the film's ×40 → ×1 drop).
- **Native moves** — long-exposure headlight trails at night; cloud shadows
  sweep the model by day.
- **Toggle** — cam-rail aperture button or key `T`; persisted in
  localStorage (`apna-shehar-lens-v1`).

## Extending the city (everything is code-side)

1. **Building** — add one line to `BUILDINGS` in `js/data.js` + one draw
   case in `js/arts.js`. Menu, thumbnails, economy and tiers follow.
2. **Resident** — `RESIDENTS` in `js/owners.js`; **max four, keep the
   `[NPC]` tag in the name** (owner rule). Bump `DEEDS_KEY` if you rename.
3. **Deed** — `ASSIGNMENTS` in `js/owners.js`, tiles as `"x,y"` strings.
4. **Knob** — add an entry to `KNOBS` (colors map or variant options) and
   read `K.paint` / `K.roof`… in the draw case via the resolved `K`.
5. Regenerate `catalog.json`, keep `js/*.js` passing
   `node --input-type=module --check`, commit.

## Constraints

- No runtime dependencies, no images, no build step — procedural canvas only.
- UI laws in `AGENTS.md` §4 (tokens, ≥44px targets, no emoji icons, …).
- `health.yml` greps pushes for token-like strings; never commit secrets.
